description: Swarog, the old Slavic smith god of the heavenly fire, a powerful dignified elder with long white hair and a long white beard, a gold circlet with a sun sign on his brow, glowing amber eyes, a scorched leather smith's apron over a dark red tunic, a heavy smith's hammer held at his chest, small glowing orange embers and sparks floating around him, warm orange firelight on his face, head and shoulders portrait, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, slavic pagan mythology, dignified, muted natural colours
